tracks.name: P² · VLABench runtime failure monitoring AUROC
tracks.split: All-task and held-out task (Episode / State failure detection)
tracks.metric: Failure detection AUROC (not policy task SR)
tracks.protocol: Episode-level and state-level receiver-operator AUROC on original VLABench failure-detection dataset. Four columns use 0..1 AUROC, NOT robot manipulation success. 600 evaluated rollouts, separate successful-demo training for P2 probe; supervised baselines may use failure labels.
tracks.trainingRegime: P2 uses 300 successful demonstrations (50/task) to train linear progress probes on fixed pi0.5 representations; SAFE-MLP/LSTM supervised comparison may use failure labels. Different label access, not equal training recipes.

results.trainingData: Comparison method with originally reported observation and/or policy features; not matched to linear probe architecture.
results.evaluationNotes: Author's source table reported AUROC, not robot task success.

results.trainingData: 300 successful demonstrations, 80/20 probe train/calibration, six VLABench tasks; no failed demonstrations used for probe supervision.
results.evaluationNotes: The 600 evaluation rollouts are 300 success/300 failure with failure timing annotated for evaluation only. AUROC is NOT task SR.

results.trainingData: Supervised baseline may use failure trajectory labels and sequence information, distinct from P² successful-only linear probe.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline AUROC only; detection time differs from compute latency.

results.trainingData: Failure-labeled baseline as described in the paper; not same label access as P² successful-only probe training.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline AUROC, state-level and episode-level detection. Different supervision; no absolute SR.
